events.title: Update 1.0.18 — The Rat Update
events.summary: Update 1.0.18 is mostly about rats. Tamed rats now have more ways to bond with you, wild rats react to more of what you do, and playing as a rat opens up new interactions. We’ll leave the details for you to discover.The update also adds two new items, new pill effects and a round of monster fixes, in time for Steam Next Fest (October 19–26).What’s newNew interactions with rats, including for players in rat form. Tamed rats grow more attached the more you feed them.New item: Chili Pepper.New item

events.title: Demo Update 1.0.9
events.summary: Fat Chance — Update 1.0.9This update adds new items and a few surprises around the mansion, alongside camera options and multiplayer fixes. Thanks for playing the demo! Here’s what’s changed:New ContentRats now have new behaviors and interactions to discover.Added cheese as a new item.Added throwable eggs that shatter on impact and make noise to distract enemies.Added the Reanimator syringe: inject yourself or a teammate to gain a temporary effect that revives them if they die while it is active

events.title: Demo Update 1.0.6
events.summary: Another small hotfix.Bug FixesFixed numbers in the HUD showing up as broken squares when the game language is set to SYSTEM on a Windows install with an unsupported system language, such as Arabic. The game now falls back to English instead.

events.title: Demo Update 1.0.5
events.summary: A small hotfix for a shadow bug.Bug FixesFixed characters and monsters casting a black smear on the floor instead of a real shadow on graphics cards without hardware ray tracing.
